# Laundry Express — AI & LLM Service Guide

> Tagline: "Pick Up • Wash • Fold • Deliver"
> Sub-tagline: "More Time For What Matters"
> Hero Headline: "Laundry Piling Up?"

## Business Overview
- Brand: Laundry Express
- Service Type: On-demand and scheduled residential/commercial laundry wash & fold service.
- Location: United States, IL · McHenry Co. · Lake in the Hills (Coordinates: 42.1903, -88.383743)
- Service Area: 30-mile radius covering Lake in the Hills, Algonquin, Crystal Lake, Huntley, Cary, Elgin, and Schaumburg (Northwest Suburbs of Illinois).
- Support Hotline: 815-575-9536
- Email: customerservice@laundryexpressservices.com
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61594071297569
- Operating Hours: Daily across two operational pickup & delivery windows:
  - Morning Window: 8:00 AM – 12:00 PM
  - Afternoon Window: 1:00 PM – 6:00 PM

## Core Pricing Rules
1. Per-Bag Standard Service:
   - Base Price: $32.50 per 13-gallon bag (about 2 loads).
   - 1 Bag = $10.00 standard pickup & delivery fee.
   - 2 or More Bags (>= 2 Bags) = 100% FREE ($0.00) pickup & delivery.
2. Per-Kilogram (Weight) Service:
   - Base Rate: $2.75 per KG.
   - Minimum Weight Threshold: 5.0 KG.
   - Initial booking authorizes estimated weight; final weight reconciled at facility scale.
3. Bundle Packages:
   - 5-Bag Saver Bundle: $145.00 (Was $162.50, includes 5 bags with free delivery).
   - 10-Bag Family Pass: $280.00 (Was $325.00, priority turnaround).
   - 25-KG Bulk Pass: $60.00 (Commercial linens and bulky items).

## Doorstep Presence Verification
- Home: Driver rings bell during the scheduled slot.
- Out of Home / Away: Customer must confirm their laundry bag is safely placed outside the door or porch.

## Proof-of-Service Guarantee
- Pickup Photo Proof: Driver captures timestamped photo when taking custody of laundry.
- Drop-Off Photo Proof: Driver captures timestamped photo upon returning clean, folded laundry outside the door.
- Both photos are immediately viewable in real-time by the customer and administrators.

## Customer Reviews & Moderation
- Eligibility: Reviews can strictly be submitted only after an order is marked 'Completed'.
- Content: 1 to 5 star rating, written feedback, and up to 3 optional photos.
- Moderation: All customer reviews are reviewed and approved by administrators before public display.
